parsed.doc_summary: San Francisco Human Rights Commission landing page. It only mentions the Fair Chance Ordinance in a one-line link blurb ("protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions"). It gives no operative requirements, thresholds, dates or citation, so no rule record was created. The page shows nothing that supports a no-rule finding.
